## WSFS Bank and Bryn Mawr Trust Expand into Lancaster; Deepening Regional Wealth, Private Banking, and Lending Services


09/23/2026


Download (opens in new window)


WILMINGTON, Del.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


WSFS Financial Corporation (Nasdaq: WSFS), the parent company of WSFS Bank and Bryn Mawr Trust, announced the opening of a new office in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. The new location solidifies WSFS Bank and Bryn Mawr Trust’s growing presence across the region, expanding a full suite of wealth management, private banking, and lending services to clients in the Lancaster community.


The WSFS Bank and Bryn Mawr Trust Team: (L-R) Jesse Ashcroft, Steven J. Cunningham, Gabriel White, William Reasner, Angel Rosario, Kristen M. Pike, Chris Ginder, and David Stork


The office, located at 201 Granite Run Drive, Suite 140, will be led by David Stork, Senior Vice President, Wealth Director, and a longtime leader in the community. In addition to serving wealth clients, the office will provide broader financial expertise through talented mortgage, middle market, private banking, and small business relationship managers. The company also intends to expand the team and hire additional talent.


“We’ve seen firsthand how Lancaster’s economy continues to flourish, from its thriving business scene to a steady wave of new residents choosing to call this city home,” said Jamie Hopkins, Executive Vice President and Chief Wealth Officer, WSFS and Bryn Mawr Trust. “Our team is excited to grow alongside this community and help our neighbors build financial security for generations to come.”


“Lancaster is a community on the rise, welcoming new residents and businesses who are building bright futures here, and access to the right banking and lending services is essential to that growth,” said Shari Kruzinski, Executive Vice President and Chief Consumer Banking Officer, WSFS Bank. “As this community grows, our team is here to open doors, whether that means connecting clients with mortgage financing solutions, guiding a business through an SBA loan, or supporting an entrepreneur ready to take the next step. That is what ‘We Stand for Service’ means to us: standing beside our neighbors and investing in their success.”


The opening of the Lancaster office is another key milestone for WSFS Bank and Bryn Mawr Trust. Last year, Bryn Mawr Trust opened a new office in Doylestown, Pennsylvania, to further expand its wealth and trust management, private banking, and investment services across the region.


For more information about the company's ongoing initiatives, visit[WSFSBank.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2FWSFSBank.com&esheet=54609048&newsitemid=20260922830518&lan=en-US&anchor=WSFSBank.com&index=1&md5=3af43e94272426d972477a1c4456f40c) or[BMT.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2FBMT.com&esheet=54609048&newsitemid=20260922830518&lan=en-US&anchor=BMT.com&index=2&md5=8e2efcbb6751d1cc351c44b03db837fa) .


**About WSFS Financial Corporation**


WSFS Financial Corporation is a multibillion-dollar financial services company. Its primary subsidiary, WSFS Bank, is the oldest and largest locally headquartered bank and wealth management franchise in the Greater Philadelphia and Delaware region. As of June 30, 2026, WSFS Financial Corporation had $22.7 billion in assets on its balance sheet and $101.7 billion in assets under management and administration. WSFS operates from 114 offices, 87 of which are banking offices, located in Pennsylvania (58), Delaware (38), New Jersey (14), Florida (2), Nevada (1) and Virginia (1) and provides comprehensive financial services including commercial banking, consumer banking, treasury management, and trust and wealth management. Other subsidiaries or divisions include Arrow Land Transfer, Bryn Mawr Trust Advisors, LLC, Bryn Mawr Trust®, The Bryn Mawr Trust Company of Delaware, Cash Connect®, NewLane Finance®, WSFS Wealth® Management, LLC, WSFS Institutional Services®, and WSFS Mortgage®. Serving the Greater Delaware Valley since 1832, WSFS Bank is one of the ten oldest banks in the United States continuously operating under the same name. For more information, please visit[www.wsfsbank.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.wsfsbank.com&esheet=54609048&newsitemid=20260922830518&lan=en-US&anchor=www.wsfsbank.com&index=3&md5=756e6b00aeea18e20cfd91f3f17ba5ac) .
